highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update.
highlights_body: This preview incorporates current upstream renderer fixes. Linux applications that rely on exact font fallback selection should review the change below before upgrading.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify an explicit family and style, or bundle a typeface, when deterministic font selection matters.

bullets.detail: Brings the current upstream renderer and its bug fixes to the 4.153 preview line without changing the managed API surface.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream fixes.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m153 engine update.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It incorporates current upstream renderer fixes while preserving the managed API surface. Linux applications that require deterministic font fallback should use an explicit family and style or a bundled typeface.
